build_STDGlobalModel: build a seasonal-trend-decomposed global model with additive decomposition and prophet for time series forecasting
load_global_model_STDGlobalModel: load a pre-trained GMModel or GMEnsemble into an STDGlobalModel instance for prediction
predict_STDGlobalModel: predict future values for time series using the seasonality-trend decomposed global model
decompose_STDGlobalModel: decompose a time series into trend and seasonality components using prophet or STL methods
deseasonal_STDGlobalModel: deseasonalize a time series by removing seasonal components using additive or multiplicative decomposition
